issuer: the Ministry of Internal Affairs (MPB), at its document centres (Qendra për Pajisje me Dokumente)
note: Read 2026-10-30. Law No. 05/L-064 on Driving Licences (Official Gazette No. 17, 10 June 2016, on gzk.rks-gov.net): the minimum age to sit the driving test for categories A2, B and BE is 18 (art. 82(1.2)); the Ministry of Internal Affairs is competent to issue licences, and a licence for categories AM to BE, B among them, is issued with a validity of ten years, renewable (art. 92). Law No. 06/L-066 (Official Gazette No. 15, 11 October 2018), which amends it, was read and changes neither article; the consolidated text of 10 July 2025 opens only through the gazette's script and wasn't read, so a later amendment, if any, isn't held. The Ministry's page on getting a licence (procedure under Administrative Instruction (MPB) No. 07/2023): a first licence is applied for in person at its document centre after passing the test, and the payment for a licence in the regular procedure is €15 (€50 more for the urgent procedure), the fee held. No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.

sources.title: Ligji Nr. 05/L-064 për Patentë Shoferi (Gazeta Zyrtare Nr. 17, 10 qershor 2016)
sources.said: Mosha minimale e lejuar e kandidatit për t’iu nënshtruar provimit për patentë shoferi është: ... tetëmbëdhjetë (18) vjet, për kategoritë A2, B dhe BE; ... Ministria e Punëve të Brendshme është kompetente për lëshim të patentës së shoferit ... Patenta e shoferit për kategoritë AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B dhe BE, lëshohet me afat vlefshmërie prej dhjetë (10) vjetësh, me mundësi vazhdimi
